text: Enrichments fill in new spreadsheet-style columns for many rows using AI, web search, scraping, and other tools
quote: An enrichment takes rows of input data and fills in new columns using AI, web searches, web scrapes, and other tools.

text: You can define an enrichment via a natural-language prompt or a structured spec and Riveter generates the rows
quote: You can build one from a natural-language prompt or a structured spec, and Riveter will generate the rows for you.

text: A scrape converts any URL into clean, easily parseable text
quote: A scrape lets you turn a URL into easily parseable text.

text: A quick_search call performs a synchronous web search and returns structured results with URLs, titles, and snippets
quote: A quick_search lets you quickly web search a query, and pull structured results with urls, titles, and snippets — synchronously, in one request.

text: A search_agent call answers a single research question directly using the same agent loop that fills enrichment cells, without needing a full enrichment setup
quote: A search_agent call asks one question and gets one AI-researched answer back — the same agent loop that fills a single enrichment cell, without setting up an enrichment.

text: You can supply a webhook_url so Riveter POSTs full run results to your endpoint on completion, stop, or finish events
quote: Pass webhook_url in the JSON body when starting a run and Riveter POSTs the full results to your URL when it finishes (events: run.completed, run.stopped, run.finished).

text: dry_run mode validates a request and returns a credit cost estimate without creating or charging anything
quote: dry_run: true — validate the request and return a credit estimate without creating or charging anything.

text: max_credits lets you set a hard ceiling; requests exceeding the estimated cost are refused before any charge occurs
quote: max_credits — a ceiling. When the estimate's maximum exceeds it, the request is refused with 422 credit_cap_exceeded and nothing is charged.

text: Riveter can be used as a remote MCP server from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI assistant
quote: Use Riveter from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI assistant. Pick one of the two ways to connect.

text: A local MCP server option runs on your own machine (Node.js + API key) for clients that can't reach remote servers
quote: Runs on your machine and needs Node.js and an API key. Use it when your client cannot reach remote servers.

text: Official SDKs handle authentication, retries on 429s/transient failures, long-polling for results, and pagination
quote: the SDKs handle auth, retries (429s and transient GET failures), the wait long-poll, polling until a run finishes (wait_for_result), and pagination

text: Projects can be scheduled to monitor sources for changes and keep enrichment data fresh over time
quote: Schedule any project to monitor for changes and keep your data fresh.

text: Supports building lead lists with ICP qualifiers, contact data enrichment, and AI-personalized outbound sentences
quote: Build custom lead lists and enrich with qualifiers for your ICP, contact data, and even personalize sentences for outbound.

text: AI agents interpret web pages the way a human would, so extraction configs keep working even after a site redesign
quote: Riveter uses AI agents that interpret pages the way a person would, so the same configuration keeps working after a redesign.

text: Can chain discovery and extraction steps, e.g. finding every business of a type in a city then pulling records from each one, in a single request
quote: It can find every dental practice in a city, then pull every dentist from each one, in a single request.

text: Fast-changing data sources (like scores or election results) can be refreshed as frequently as every minute
quote: For fast moving data like scores or election results, you can refresh as often as every minute.

text: Enrichments can read PDFs and images, call third-party APIs, and merge those results with web-sourced data into one output
quote: It reads PDFs and images, calls third party APIs as part of a workflow, and combines those results with data pulled from the web in a single output.
